text:
alex: handing off primary for the evening. ongoing alerts: embedding-queue errors spiking, p95 latency up, some 503s from prim-sec. i'm heading offline in 20m but leaving the immediate mitigation steps.

maria: got it. what's customer impact right now? any single-customer pages?

alex: no single-customer pager. broad increase in generation errors for ~2% of requests. high-volume customers see elevated tail latencies and retries. monitoring shows embeddings queue depth has grown to 420 (typical <50).

lee: incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-queue-depth > 400 in eu-west. incidents/INC-2026 created.

samir: thanks. alex — what mitigations are active now?

alex: active mitigations:
- scaled prim-sec embeddings pool from 6->10 instances (manual scale, autoscaler still flakey)
- enabled fallback-route to dedicated-cluster for customers on reserved plans (policy v2)
- rate-limit soft-paces at ingress: 5% shedding for anonymous traffic
- KV prefetch increase applied to pods: PREFETCH_BATCH=64

maria: can you paste the exact kubectl commands and runbook link?

alex: yep:
```
# scale embedding pool
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/embeddings-prim --replicas=10
# toggle fallback route
redwoodctl routes update --policy fallback=dedicated-cluster
```
Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/g/runbooks/embeddings-queue-eviction

samir: are we seeing any errors in the worker logs? snippet?

alex: sample from worker stderr:
```
2026-03-14T19:12:07Z ERROR evictor.go:142 kv evict attempt failed: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-14T19:12:08Z WARN queue.go:78 enqueue failed: capacity exceeded, retrying
```

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026.03.14-emb-fix started by @alex (sha: b7c9f2d)

lee: job started, ETA ~7m. if deployment fails, fallback plan is to start the manual worker flush:
- run: /ops/runbooks/flush-embeddings-workers.sh

maria: coverage: samir will take primary for next 2h, then lee will take over. i'm secondary until 02:00 UTC. alex you're primary until handoff at 20:30 UTC?

alex: correct. i'm primary until 20:30 UTC, samir will shadow now and take over at 20:00 if all stable. leaving notes in the bridge.

samir: taking prim at 20:00. current checklist i'm following:
- confirm deployment progress + pod readiness
- watch embeddings-queue depth and p95 latency (dash: /dash/emb-q)
- confirm fallback route accepted and traffic shifted (~10-15m)
- validate no customer-facing 5xx spikes
- be ready to trigger manual flush if queue > 600

lee: adding watch commands:
```
# watch queue depth
kubectl -n inference exec -it pod/queue-exporter -- curl localhost:9100/metrics | grep embeddings_queue_depth
# tail logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embeddings -f --tail=100
```

alex: known constraints/coverage gaps:
- autoscaler not reacting to queue spikes (ticket filed INF-3421)
- EU region has lower spare capacity — fallback might increase latency for some customers
- no hotfix for evictor race yet, deployment should help but may require rollback plan

maria: customer comms? do we need an incident page? support bubbling? :loudspeaker:

samir: for now ops note to support: "We're seeing elevated embeddings latency/errors; mitigation in progress, some traffic routed to dedicated infra. No customer data loss." I'll DM support and set a canned response.

alex: leaving last checked metrics at 19:24 UTC: queue_depth=420, p95=1.8s, error_rate=2.1%

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026.03.14-emb-fix succeeded (sha: b7c9f2d) in 6m 12s

lee: deployment successful. starting validation window.

samir: validation: queue_depth dropping -> 180 in 8m, p95 -> 1.1s, error_rate -> 0.9%

maria: great. samir take over at 20:00 and update this thread when you are fully primary. alex, enjoy the evening.

samir: taking over now as primary. monitoring and bridge active. I will escalate if any regression. :thumbsup: 

alex: thanks team, leaving notes in case of handback:
- if we see a regression after 30m rollback to previous deployment:
  redwoodctl deploy rollback --service embeddings --to sha: a12b3c4
- if queue keeps growing despite rollback, start emergency flush and notify SRE on-call

samir: noted. last message ts 20:50 UTC — continuing watch, will update if anything changes.
